ios.desc:
P is a water reminder for iPhone and Apple Watch that doesn’t make you log every glass. You log a bathroom visit in seconds, and P reminds you to drink water when it’s been a while. P tracks output, not intake: peer-reviewed studies support 24-hour pee frequency as a practical hydration indicator in healthy adults.

P also works as a bladder diary to track how often you pee: log each bathroom visit from your iPhone or Apple Watch, add notes, and keep a record to discuss with your doctor.

It’s great for Apple Watch or as a Lock Screen Widget, and not as complicated as a water tracker. Who wants to use an annoying, complicated water tracker to drink water? Up your hydration game with this app!

Try it out, and see how this drink water reminder app can keep you aware of your body.

Key features:
- Drink water when your body needs it most, instead of based on just water intake
- Great Apple Watch app: Put it on your watch face for fast access while you head to the restroom!
- Customizable drink water reminder notifications
- Apple Health integration
- Lock Screen widgets
- Home Screen widgets
- Hydration calendar (pee count per day)
- Add notes on pees
- Volume tracking: record void volume in mL or oz for a complete voiding diary
- See Where You Peed: include location on pees for a low-effort journal of your life
- Tell Siri to “Log a P”
- Data export as CSV
- Supported by scientific research
- Add friends so you can remind them to drink water
- Earn your scroll: Water Break blocks apps you choose until you take a sip of water

If you’ve ever had a UTI or kidney stones, you know how important it is to drink water. Hydration is so important! There can be many benefits of drinking water, like weight loss, healthy skin, mental clarity, and much more. Dehydration can hold you back from being your best self.

Now it’s easy to know when it’s water time. This hydration app gets you in tune with your body, especially when you need to drink water most.

P is like a fitness game, taking the water tracker concept and turning it around, so you don’t need to track water intake. It’s a much simpler free water drinking reminder app.

Don’t break that streak! You can even see where you stack up against the streaks of other users on the Leaderboard.

Even though P is designed to help you drink water as a hydration app and water drinking reminder app, you may also want to use it as a simple pee tracker or bathroom tracker. With volume tracking, P supports proper voiding diarie

quotes.text:
Ha I actually made an iOS & watchOS app based on that side of the equation after thinking "what's the minimum input I can provide for good hydration reminders?"

It gives a reminder to drink water any time it's been three hours since you've peed...

https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/pee-see-drink-more-water/id1090749982?mt=8

Not super scientific, but less of a hassle than tracking water input and it tends to adapt well to factor in things like exercise where more water is needed. It also tends to even out over time when drinking alcohol or coffee. Urine color can also vary depending on foods, like how B12 makes it fluorescent yellow, so the time factor can be another useful indicator.
quotes.story_title: A command line script to remind you to drink water
